# Troubleshooting

## "This profile is private and the account you are logged in as does not follow it"

Exactly what it says. That is a server-side restriction, not a bug. Follow the
account and wait to be accepted, or log in as an account that already follows
it. There is no workaround, by design.

## Zero posts found on a public profile

Likely an Instagram markup change. Open the profile in the same Chromium
window yourself to confirm what you can actually see, then
[file a bug](https://github.com/tungufoss/instagram-archiver/issues/new?template=bug_report.md).

## A video has no sound

Instagram delivered picture and sound as separate files and `ffmpeg` was not
there to merge them. [Install ffmpeg](install.qmd#ffmpeg) and run again with
`--force`.

## A carousel slide's video was missed

Raise `VIDEO_SETTLE` in `src/instagram_archiver/config.py`. Each video slide
waits for playback to start before the file is requested, and a slow
connection can need longer.

## How do I switch Instagram accounts?

Delete the [session directory](options.qmd#where-the-session-lives) and run
`login` again.

## A CSV opens as mojibake

It should not - CSV and log files carry a byte-order mark for exactly this
reason. If it still happens, check that your spreadsheet is not overriding the
encoding on import.

## Known limits

- **Video quality is whatever Instagram serves your browser** - typically a
  compressed rendition, not an original master.
- **Stories, highlights and archived posts are not covered.**
- **Comment capture is thin.** Only what the page has loaded is read, which is
  a handful on a busy post.
- **Follower lists are complete only for accounts you can log in as.** See
  [what is visible](visibility.qmd#follower-names).
- **Instagram changes its markup without warning**; selectors may need
  updating.

## Your data

The session directory holds a live logged-in session. **Treat it like a
password** - do not copy or share it. Downloaded media is gitignored.

Report a security issue through
[SECURITY.md](https://github.com/tungufoss/instagram-archiver/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
